mapper.sql: id, project_id, chapter_id, storyboard_revision_id, source_hash, continuity_plan_id, continuity_plan_revision, continuity_report_revision, style_policy_version, provider_policy_version, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, issues_json::text AS issues_json, status, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT ch.current_storyboard_revision_id AS storyboard_revision_id, ch.source_hash FROM chapters ch JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = ch.story_version_id WHERE ch.id = #{chapterId} AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND ch.current_storyboard_revision_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT id, batch_id, visual_beat_id, scene_id, beat_row_version, prompt, negative_prompt, character_snapshot_json::text AS character_snapshot_json, references_json::text AS references_json, continuity_semantic_hash, input_fingerprint FROM storyboard_generation_beat_snapshots WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY created_at, visual_beat_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO storyboard_generation_batches (id, project_id, chapter_id, storyboard_revision_id, source_hash, continuity_plan_id, continuity_plan_revision, continuity_report_revision, style_policy_version, provider_policy_version, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, issues_json, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{chapterId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{storyboardRevisionId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{sourceHash}, #{continuityPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{continuityPlanRevision}, #{continuityReportRevision}, #{stylePolicyVersion}, #{providerPolicyVersion}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{issuesJson}::jsonb, #{status}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO storyboard_generation_beat_snapshots (id, batch_id, visual_beat_id, scene_id, beat_row_version, prompt, negative_prompt, character_snapshot_json, references_json, continuity_semantic_hash, input_fingerprint) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{batchId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{visualBeatId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{sceneId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{beatRowVersion}, #{prompt}, #{negativePrompt}, #{characterSnapshotJson}::jsonb, #{referencesJson}::jsonb, #{continuitySemanticHash}, #{inputFingerprint})
